rows.summary: Open middle-clicked links inside the embedded browser pane as a new managed browser tab subject to URL policy.
rows.status_evidence: Ported in rune-desktop #268 (52801613): LifeSpanHandler::on_before_popup + on_open_urlfrom_tab route middle-clicked links and user-activated HTTP(S) popups into policy-checked managed browser tabs in the opener's session (engine binary inert until next engine publish).
rows.risks: Red flag: gui-plugins/browser; new-tab opens must pass browser-policy checks and inherit agent-tab isolation.

rows.title: fix(session-ui): keep execute details padding visible when code and output are long
rows.summary: Keep bottom padding and both Code and Output sections accessible inside the Execute details dialog when code and output are long.
rows.status_evidence: Verified on dev: crates/session-view/src/tools/details.rs:108 wraps Execute Code and Output sections in scroller("body") with bottom padding so both sections and padding remain reachable when long.

rows.title: feat(desktop): browser pane UI, chrome polish, Settings > Browser, and app links [split from #63002]
rows.summary: App-side browser chrome polish, refusal notices, plain errors, Find UI, Settings > Browser page, and chat/terminal link routing into the browser pane.
rows.status_evidence: Chrome polish, refusal notices + 500 ms guard, plain errors, Find UI, device toolbar (#270 17194075), and Settings > Browser with capability gating, live two-way sitePermissions sync, and search Advanced reveal (#276 c6bd83d0) landed on dev; chat/terminal/OSC-8 link routing remains in BROWSER-UI PR 3.
rows.risks: Link routing must always delegate scheme/URL decisions to crates/browser-policy.

rows.title: feat(desktop): oc-preview:// scheme, isolated preview contexts, raw file:// ban, and Files/chat HTML preview routing [split from #63002]
rows.summary: Serve local, remote, and artifact previews through isolated per-preview CefRequestContexts and oc-preview:// with open-handle path verification, strict CSP/Connection-Allowlist, and raw file:// ban.
rows.status_evidence: Split from UP-095 (#63002) into PREVIEWS (threat model & 3-PR plan documented; PR #281 oc-preview:// engine scheme + isolated CefRequestContext open for review).
rows.risks: Security-critical: symlink/TOCTOU, loopback/LAN/WebRTC exfiltration, credential isolation, raw file:// ban; requires newly published engine binary.

rows.title: feat(desktop): experimental.browser v4 RPC client, typed agent executors, PromptGate, and tunnel proxy [split from #63002]
rows.summary: Replace local rune_mcp browser tools on modern servers with pure-Rust experimental.browser v4 RPC client, 45 typed executors, <=1 s durable PromptGate, and authenticated remote tunnel proxy.
rows.status_evidence: Pure-Rust experimental.browser v4 RPC client, AttachMachine, authenticated half-open TunnelProxy, and browser-policy::agent landed in #275 (c397d0b9); navigation/read/act/profile executors, BuiltinPromptGate, and rune_mcp cutover follow in BROWSER-TOOLS PR 2-4.
rows.risks: Remote server attachment must fail closed until engine Ready.remote_proxy lands (WS-1 Phase 3a); older servers must keep full rune_mcp fallback.

rows.title: fix(ui): show text field and line comment focus in high contrast mode
rows.summary: Keep text field, search bar, palette search, and line-comment focus rings and borders visible under forced-colors / Windows High Contrast mode.
rows.status_evidence: Rune maps Windows Contrast themes via opencode-ui::themes::contrast; text fields, search inputs, and line comment boxes need forced-colors border/invalid/focus-ring verification and parity.

rows.title: fix(app): recover child session permissions after reconnect
rows.summary: Sync both permissions and forms across running descendants and any child session with cached requests on open, inactive tab poll, inbox settle, and reconnect.
rows.status_evidence: Verified on dev: apps/desktop/src/session/meta/status.rs read_open_requests() only fetches running descendants (skipping idle children with stale cached requests), and poll() for inactive tabs/Inbox only fetches the root session id.
rows.risks: Must still avoid booting cold idle subagent locations that have no running work or cached requests.

rows.title: fix(app): go back and forward with the mouse buttons on desktop
rows.summary: Navigate back and forward through desktop route history when mouse Back/Forward side buttons are released.
rows.status_evidence: Rune already maps mouse side buttons to PointerButton::Back and PointerButton::Forward (crates/rune/src/window.rs:762-763), and GoBack/GoForward exist in keymap, but apps/desktop does not handle PointerButton::Back/Forward yet.
rows.risks: Ensure embedded browser pane / pointer capture does not conflict with desktop history navigation.

rows.title: fix(browser): confirm before clearing browsing data
rows.summary: Require an explicit confirmation step before clearing browsing data in Settings > Browser.
rows.status_evidence: Settings > Browser Clear browsing data (#276 c6bd83d0) currently clears immediately on button press without a confirmation prompt.
